qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Colgate commands a dominant ~41.4% global value share in toothpaste and ~32.4% in manual toothbrushes across 200+ countries, reinforced by massive Lindy brand awareness, ubiquitous shelf-space distribution, and strong dental professional endorsements. Hill's Pet Nutrition adds a high-margin science-based moat driven by veterinarian recommendations and therapeutic formulas. Demonstrated pricing power through repeated mid-single digit price increases passing through commodity inflation while maintaining or expanding market share. Empirical moat proof: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 35.6%, operating ROIC exceeding 100%, and gross margins near 60%. Primary erosion risks include private label encroachment in basic tiers and retail channel consolidation.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Unrivaled global oral care franchise commanding >41% worldwide toothpaste market share alongside Hill's high-margin science-based pet nutrition. Demonstrated pricing power across multiple inflationary cycles with multi-year GAAP ROIC averaging >35%. Fully insulated from 5 macrotrends with local supply chains and non-discretionary daily consumable habits. Robust balance sheet with 12x+ interest coverage and Net Debt repayable in <1.6 years of Owner FCF. [5-10Y g: volume 1.5% + price 2.0% + mix/reinvestment 1.5% - input cost drag 0.5% + buybacks 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year financial history demonstrates extraordinary capital efficiency: 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 35.6% (operating ROIC >100%), gross margins consistently 59-60%, and Owner FCF conversion averages >120% of GAAP Net Income ($3.48B Owner FCF vs $2.13B GAAP NI in 2025). As of Q3 2026, organic sales grew 3.6% (+1.7% volume, +2.0% price) with Hill's organic sales up 5.7% and toothpaste global value share steady at 41.4%. Balance sheet carries $6.87B long-term debt against $1.29B cash (net debt $5.58B), generating $3.31B EBIT with $267M interest expense for 12.4x interest coverage, well above safety thresholds. 62 consecutive years of dividend increases.
